description: A scholarly magic user capable of manipulating the structures of reality through study and formulae.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.tldr: Cast arcane spells using Intelligence from a spellbook containing your learned formulae.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.tldr: Regain some expended spell slots during a short rest once per day by studying your spellbook.

features.name: Arcane Tradition
features.tldr: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, granting specialized features.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Arcane Tradition Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Arcane Tradition.
